text.p: -- James Capel said on Tuesday it started Celesc as long-term buy.

-- "Celesc trades on the lowest valuation ratios among the distributors, primarily because it is not officially included in the privatization programs," analyst Luciana Portolano wrote in a Dec 9 analysis.

-- "Celesc has strong cash generation and very low indebtedness, which have given it the basis to carry out an aggressive investment program over the next five years. Investments will be strategically concentrated in generation of energy."
-- Privatization of Celesc is unlikely soon.
-- Celesc's shares were up 0.06 to 1.30 reais in Sao Paulo on Tuesday.
